harm.rule: (a) DEV harm measure of the repaired model against its pre-night model passes: W1r vs N' and W2r vs W1r (in_dist drop <= 1.5, no family fires: drop > 5 points and paired 95% interval of b - a below 0)

first_try.rule: (b) C2 DEV first try right within 2 points of the unrepaired night: W1r - W1 and W2r - W2 >= -2 (paired bootstrap point estimate, c2_pilot.boot)

proved_wrong.rule: PROVED WRONG: after repair, DEV in_dist is still more than 1.5 below the pre-night model at point 1 (W1r vs N') on both parents (point 2 reported too); rreport decides "both parents"

report_only.rule: E against R (in_dist, fired families), the update counts, everything against N'

s100.passes_rule: PASS = (a) and (b) at both points on both parents
